fidget_1: Somewhere a kettle is boiling without me.
fidget_2: The crystals hum when nobody moves.
door_open_0: The lock gives with a heavy clunk.
door_open_1: The key turns and the door slides away.
door_open_2: A perfect fit. The way is open.
door_open_3: Iron grinds, and the door parts.
door_locked_0: Locked. The plate is marked with a colour.
door_locked_1: This door wants a key of its own colour.
door_locked_2: Locked tight. Look for a matching key.
key_have: You already carry a key of that colour.
tip_lift: Hold UP or DOWN to ride the lift.
tip_switch: Press UP or DOWN to throw the lever.
tip_door_up: Press UP to go through the door.
tip_oneway: This door only opens from the other side.
leave_need_gatekey: The gate key is still somewhere in here.
leave_need_sigil: The sigil must not stay behind.
token_gatekey: A gate key! It opens a gate on the Vale path.
token_bolt: The lantern burns brighter: one more bolt at a time.
token_stones: A handful of stones to throw.
token_boots: Spring boots! You jump much higher.
token_ward: A ward of light surrounds you.
xfm_lamp: The lamp's glow returns you to yourself.
xfm_moth: Your coat unfolds into soft grey wings!
xfm_bell: You climb into the brass diving bell.
rapid: Rapid fire! Five bolts at a time.
embers5: Five ember charges. Use them well.
rune_hint: A carved rune. Find them all, in order.
rune_bonus: V-A-L-E in order! A 4,000 point bonus!
flag: The lantern post is lit. You will return here.
gate_need: A crystal gate. It needs a gate key.
gate_sigils: The Spire's gate answers only to all three sigils.
regent_down: The Regent falls! Strike the heart crystal!
shop_poor: Tolly shakes his head: 'Not enough shards, friend.'
shop_full: Tolly: 'You can't carry any more of that.'
shop_form: Tolly: 'Come back when you're yourself again.'
shop_map: Tolly only trades inside the stages.
save_where: You can only save on the Vale map.

tip_shard.title: Shards
lines: Green shards are the Vale's coin.
Tolly the pedlar trades them for
health, bolts, embers and a ward.
Open his pack with B (or Back).

tip_berry.title: Berries
lines: Berries! Sixteen of them make
a whole new heart.

tip_platform.title: Floating Planks
lines: Ride the planks where they go.
Jump to leave one, or hold DOWN
and jump to drop through.

tip_crate.title: Crates
lines: Crates hide useful things.
Shoot one to break it open.

sigil_root.title: The Sigil of Root
lines: A knot of living green, warm in my hand.
The first of the three sigils.
Two more wait beyond the Vale path.

sigil_tide.title: The Sigil of Tide
lines: It ripples like water held still.
The second sigil.
Only the Sigil of Ember remains.

sigil_ember.title: The Sigil of Ember
lines: It glows like a coal that never cools.
All three sigils are yours.
The Glass Spire's gate will open now.

help.title: How to Play
lines: Move: arrows, WASD, D-pad or left stick
Jump: Z, Alt, Ctrl or K  (pad A)
Fire: X, Shift, Space or J  (pad X or B)
Climb vines and look: UP / DOWN
Items: I or Enter  (pad Y)
Tolly's pack: B  (pad Back)
Menu: Esc or P (pad Start)

story.title: The Vale
lines: Each night I light the Vale's lamps.
Each morning the crystals sing them out.
Last night the singing stopped.

story.title: Sable
lines: The Glass Regent took the three sigils,
Root, Tide and Ember, into his Spire.
Without them, the Vale sets like glass.

story.title: Sable
lines: Walk the Vale path, lamplighter.
Find the sigils.
Break the Spire's heart.
I will find you on the way.

owl_hollow.title: Sable
lines: Hoo. You came, lamplighter.
The hollow is overgrown, but it
remembers the old paths.

owl_hollow.title: Orrin
lines: Where do I start?

owl_hollow.title: Sable
lines: Climb the vines, find the gate key.
Keys of colour open doors of colour.
And mind the burrowhogs.

owl_mines.title: Sable
lines: The miners fled when the Regent's
drones came. Their levers still work.

owl_mines.title: Orrin
lines: And the Sigil of Root?

owl_mines.title: Sable
lines: Deep below, past the crumbling floors.
Stones break cracked rock. Try them.

owl_aqueduct.title: Sable
lines: The old aqueduct is flooded.
No lamplighter can swim that deep...

owl_aqueduct.title: Orrin
lines: ...but a diving bell could.

owl_aqueduct.title: Sable
lines: Exactly. And the lamp will
bring you back to yourself.

owl_canopy.title: Sable
lines: The Thornwood grows too tall
to climb. You will need wings.

owl_canopy.title: Orrin
lines: Wings. Of course. Why not.

owl_foundry.title: Sable
lines: The Regent's foundry pours glass
day and night. It is very hot.

owl_foundry.title: Orrin
lines: I'll keep off the orange parts.

owl_foundry.title: Sable
lines: Embers melt his sentries.
Tolly sells them, if you have shards.

owl_spire.title: Sable
lines: This is his Spire. Above us
the heart crystal holds the Vale still.

owl_spire.title: Orrin
lines: Then I'll put out his light
and give the Vale its own back.

sign_hollow_1.title: Old Signpost
lines: MOSSGATE HOLLOW
Mind the vines, they are older
than the path.

sign_hollow_2.title: Scratched Note
lines: Springs in the moss.
Jump on them from above.

sign_mines_1.title: Miners' Board
lines: LIFT: hold UP to rise.
LEVER opens the east bridge.
Cracked rock: stand clear.

sign_mines_2.title: Warning
lines: Soft floor ahead. Keep moving!

sign_aqueduct_1.title: Keeper's Plaque
lines: The bell stays in the cistern.
Leave the water and the lamp
will make you walk again.

sign_canopy_1.title: Carved Bark
lines: The glowing boughs come and go.
Count before you jump.

sign_foundry_1.title: Foundry Rule
lines: NO LAMPLIGHTERS.
(Someone has crossed that out.)

sign_vale_1.title: Waystone
lines: The Vale path. Walk to a
glowing marker to enter a stage.
You can save here from the menu.

note_hollow.title: Orrin's Notebook
lines: Day one. The lamps are dark.
Sable says to follow the path.
My boots are already wet.

note_mines.title: A Miner's Letter
lines: Mara, we are leaving the mine.
The drones don't sleep and the lift
groans. Take the key by the lamp.

note_foundry.title: Regent's Order
lines: All living growth is flawed.
Glass does not rot.
Pour faster.

ending.title: Dawn
lines: The Spire rings once and falls quiet.
Down in the Vale the crystals
begin, softly, to sing.

ending.title: Sable
lines: Well lit, lamplighter.
Hoo. Now go home and sleep.

ending.title: Orrin
lines: Tonight I'll light the lamps
a little early.

regent_meet.title: The Glass Regent
lines: A lamplighter. How quaint.
Every light in this Vale
ends in my glass.

regent_meet.title: Orrin
lines: Then I've come to take it back,
one lamp at a time.

regent_meet.title: The Glass Regent
lines: Come, then. Burn bright.
Glass remembers every flame.
